gates.description: Report must use percentile metrics (p95 or p99), not averages
Report must include pass/fail verdict against SLA
Report must identify the performance bottleneck
Report must include specific remediation recommendations
Report must not rely solely on average latency
Report must include error rate under load

anti_patterns.description: Reporting only average latency — hides p99 outliers that matter most
Running tests on a single-node dev server and extrapolating results
Only testing /health or one endpoint instead of realistic user behavior mix
Sending full load instantly instead of ramping — creates thundering herd
Running one performance test before launch and never testing again

escalation_triggers: System cannot meet SLA at projected 6-month traffic level
Performance regression detected but responsible team disputes the results
Test environment is inadequate and operations won't provision a better one
Root cause analysis points to a third-party service as the bottleneck
Performance fix requires architectural change beyond the team's scope
Cost of scaling to meet SLA exceeds the allocated budget

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with SLA and performance requirements

output_certifications: Performance test report exists with p50/p95/p99 metrics
Specific recommendations provided with expected improvement
Error rate under peak load documented
